items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: The drummer was Maurice Purtill, the bass player was Rolly Bundock.

ctx.x: No kidding. And was Tex Benecke?
Tex was in the band. Al Klink, Willie Schwartz, Hal McIntyre. The drummer was Maurice Purtill, the bass player was Rolly Bundock. He was replaced by Trigger Alpert.
